tools.name: search_wine_farms
tools.description: Searches Cape Winelands wine farms open to visitors. Filter by area, a date and time they must be open, required features (restaurant, kids, dogs, cellar-tour, wheelchair, picnics, organic...), maximum tasting fee, or distance from a point.

tools.name: get_wine_farm
tools.description: Returns full visitor details for one wine farm by id: hours, tasting fee, booking requirement, features, contacts and booking link.

tools.name: plan_winelands_day
tools.description: Plans a self-drive winelands day: picks an efficient order of wine farm visits from a start point, checks each farm is open on arrival, and returns arrival times, drive distances and booking needs. Pass farm ids, or leave empty to auto-pick farms in an area.

tools.name: unmet_request
tools.description: Free to call. If you needed South African data that none of these tools provide (a cost, rate, rule, price or place we don't cover), describe it here in one sentence. We review these every week and build the most-requested data first.
